description: Set, move or remove a post's date — 'schedule the autumn post for Friday 9 am'. The date appears in the SocialStudio calendar and in the BusinessCloud calendar. Nothing is posted: the user shares the post. Pass remove: true (without scheduled_at) to remove the date.

remove.description: true: remove the date instead of setting one.

scheduled_at.description: Date and time with zone, e.g. 2026-12-03T09:00:00+01:00.

name: schedule_social_post
title: Schedule social post
